title: Indexed entries of a duplicated bit string
statement: Let $x$ be a finite bit string and let $p$ be a natural number. In the string formed by replacing each bit of $x$ by two consecutive copies, the entries at indices $2p$ and $2p+1$ are both equal to the entry of $x$ at index $p$, with out-of-range lookups interpreted as absent.
